name: Sexual Equality
overview: Scripture reveals that both male and female are created in God's image, affirming their equal value and dignity before Him (Genesis 1:27). Women held significant roles in God's plan, as seen in Deborah's leadership as a judge in Israel (Judges 4:4) and Mary Magdalene being the first to witness the resurrected Christ (Mark 16:9). Wisdom and the proclamation of God's word are personified as female, highlighting the honored role of women in conveying divine truth (Proverbs 1:20; Psalms 68:11). These passages together affirm a God-ordained equality rooted in creation and purposeful service.
